title: Add regression blame and diff-summary CI check for prompt-set evaluations
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: CI currently reports failing prompt-set metrics but gives limited context to quickly identify the source of a regression. This PR introduces a two-part CI hook: (1) regression-blame which correlates failing prompt cohorts to recent changes in prompt definitions, eval configs, and model pinning; (2) diff-summary which renders a compact human-readable summary of model-output changes for affected prompts. The goal is to reduce mean time-to-diagnose for eval regressions and to make gating decisions actionable. Implementation notes: regression-blame walks the prompt-set git history and the eval config commits in the last 30 days to produce candidate commit ranges; it then scores candidates by overlap with changed prompt IDs, changed tokenization metadata, and run-time seed/temperature differences. diff-summary runs a lightweight paired-output comparator that highlights token-level deltas, normalized scores, and a short semantic-change heuristic (BLEU/ROUGE delta + embedding cosine delta threshold). The CI hook plugs into existing eval GH actions and produces an artifact JSON and a Markdown summary comment. Checklist: [x] core algorithm and scoring, [x] GH action integration, [x] unit tests for scoring heuristics, [x] docs + runbook snippet, [x] small-scale perf bench on large prompt sets (< 10s per 100 prompts on CI runner). Related: Linear ENG-1882, ENG-2001. Jira: SUP-433 (customer report that prompted this work). Usage: when a gated eval fails, the CI will post a comment with a compact diff-summary and a ranked list of probable commits to inspect. The comment links to the full JSON artifact and a generated local html for quick triage. Notes for reviewers: the scoring weights are configurable via eval-config.yaml; defaults are conservative to avoid noisy blame; thresholds are documented. Rollout: implemented behind a feature flag eval_ci_blame enabled for 2 teams initially. This description contains implementation rationale, test plan, and rollout guidance in one continuous string.

testing_summary: Integration: GH action simulated eval failure and produced artifact in under 9s on Ubuntu-latest runner.
Flakiness: added retry logic around git history fetch; observed transient network failure once during CI rerun but resolved by 1 retry.
release_notes: Add CI hook that posts a ranked 'regression blame' and concise diff-summary when eval gating fails, improving triage speed for prompt regressions.
guidance_snippet: Interpreting the blame scores: higher score => higher overlap of changed prompt IDs and config diffs; use the diff-summary to validate semantic change before reverting commits.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated behind eval_ci_blame; enable for a subset of repos first and monitor CI artifact size; storage retention set to 7 days by default.
